 ORDER (Judgement of the Court was delivered by S.M.Subramaniam J.)
The judgement dated dated 27.10.2015 made in W.A.Nos.1228 of 2015 and 1419 of 2015 is sought to be reviewed in the present review application.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Review Application No.50 of 2016 2.
The learned Special Government Pleader, Mr.A.Selvendran would submit that the award in land acquisition proceedings was passed on 23.09.1986.
Possession was taken over by the Government on 30.10.1986 and it was allotted for the Tamil Nadu Housing Board, requisitioning body.
3. It is not in dispute that the compensation determined had been settled.
The lands acquired under the Act absolutely vest with the Government.
Title transferred in the name of the Government in the present case and the Government allotted the land to the requisitioning body i.e., Tamil Nadu Housing Board.
Thus, re-conveyance of land cannot be claimed as a right by the erstwhile land owners.
4. The petitioner is unable to make out any case warranting interference under the review jurisdiction.

Since there is no error apparent on the face of the record, we are not inclined to entertain the review application.
